subject: MAP stoplight: final signoff, signature timing & start date
messages:
From: Jenna Holloway <jenna.h@weathertail.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.r@weathertail.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP update + final timing questions

Hi Olga,

Thanks for sending the updated MAP this morning. Tom and I reviewed the milestones and overall evaluation plan. A couple quick items before we confirm the internal go/no-go: 

- We need clarity on the signature window: can Redwood commit to signatures between Sept 13-15 to meet our internal procurement cutover?
- Start date: if signatures are complete by Sept 15, can we request a hard start of Oct 1?
- Any final SLAs or onboarding deliverables that would be excluded from the SOW at this point?

Attached: MAP_Weathertail_v3.pdf (with highlighted acceptance criteria).

Goal: Final decision from both sides by end of day Mon Sep 13 so execs can sign off. Is that feasible from your side?

Thanks,
Jenna
Jenna Holloway
Head of Product Ops, Weathertail Retail
jenna.h@weathertail.com
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Holloway <jenna.h@weathertail.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP update + final timing questions

Jenna — great to hear you and Tom reviewed this. Quick response and suggested next steps below.

Summary / proposed cadence:
- Signoff window: Redwood legal ready to prepare DocuSign envelope; proposed execution window Sept 14–16 to accommodate signer availability. Please confirm Weathertail signer availability on those dates.
- Start date: Oct 1 looks good from our side — we’ll reserve onboarding capacity. If signatures slip past Sept 18 we’d need to slide to Oct 8.
- SLAs/SOW: the attached SOW draft includes standard Redwood-SLA-Standard.pdf references; Kimberly, noted below, will flag any exceptions.

Action items for internal:
- Rafael: coordinate final commercial terms and confirm any discount approvals needed for the October start.
- Priyom: plan CS onboarding resources for the Oct 1 kickoff; hold a tentative week-1 slot.
- Kimberly: legal review of SOW redlines (see attachment).

Attached: MAP_Weathertail_v3.pdf, SOW_Weathertail_draft.docx, Redwood-SLA-Standard.pdf

If everyone is aligned I’ll queue the DocuSign and loop in Finance for invoice timing.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

On Fri, Sep 10, 2027 at 09:05 AM Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com> wrote:
> Jenna — great to hear you and Tom reviewed this. Quick response and suggested next steps below.

Thanks, Olga. Legal reviewed the SOW and MAP. High level: 
- We have one minor redline around section 3.2 (data retention window). Proposed fix: add a 45-day data purge confirmation in appendix A. That is purely operational and does not affect price/timing.
- SLA is standard; no enterprise exceptions requested.
- We can approve the DocuSign envelope and signature cadence for Sept 14–16 once the SOW incorporates the 45-day clause.

Please ask the customer to confirm primary signer name and timezone for the DocuSign routing. Once I have that I will pre-approve the envelope and instruct Finance how to route the initial invoice (Net 30 from signature).

KK

Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Jenna — thanks and confirmed. Per Kimberly’s request we added the 45-day purge clause in appendix A of the SOW (see attached).

Final status: GREEN / proceed.
- DocuSign envelope queued for Sept 14 at 09:00 PT. Primary signer: Tom Rivera (tom.r@weathertail.com).
- Finance: invoice Net 30 from signature; Marissa will send Terms & Invoice instructions after signature.
- CS: Priyom has tentatively reserved onboarding resources for Oct 1 start; final confirmation after signature.

Jenna — please confirm Tom will be available on Sept 14 between 09:00–12:00 PT for e-signing. If yes I will send the DocuSign link and put the MAP into production readiness.

Thanks all — this should get us across the finish line.

Olga Petrov
